title: Native reference choice
requirements: Build a native HTML select labelled Reference choice, with Alpha (value alpha), Unavailable Beta (value beta, disabled), Gamma (value gamma) and Delta (value delta). Start with Alpha selected and display alpha in an output. Keyboard changes commit enabled options, skip disabled Beta, retain one selected option and synchronize the output. Repeated keyboard round trips keep focus on the control; clicking its visible label restores focus from an outside button. Include a Remove reference fixture button followed by an After fixture button; removing the fixture leaves keyboard navigation to the latter available. This task is limited to native Chromium HTML select semantics, not a custom popup or Proto navigation/commit separation.
